## Limits

JSON: 32768 UTF-8 bytes; nodes: 128; depth: 8; each text property: 8192 UTF-8 bytes.

All properties are literal strings. A root has no parent; every other node has exactly one. Unknown fields, broken references, cycles and unreachable nodes are rejected.
